# 202 — External_Connected

Indicates that an explicit connection operation completed successfully according to the observed API&#39;s contract\.

[All events](index.md) · [External category](Category_External.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ExternalEvents.Connected%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%29)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 202 |
| Name | External_Connected |
| Category | [External](Category_External.md) |
| Event class | OperationalInformation |
| Log level | Information |
| Status | Stable |
| Introduced | 0.0.10 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.External.Connected(@externalName, @operationName, @operationId);
```

**Trigger:** Emit immediately after the connection API reports successful establishment or acquisition, before performing subsequent business operations\.

**Message template:** Connected to external dependency \{ExternalName\}\. Operation: \{OperationName\}\. Attempt: \{OperationId\}\.

## Arguments

- `externalName` (`string`): The logical dependency name used by the beginning event\.
- `operationName` (`string`): The logical connection operation name used by the beginning event\.
- `operationId` (`string`): The identifier of the successfully completed connection attempt\.

## Remarks

- Use the same external name, operation name, and operation identifier as External\_Connecting\.
- Success is limited to the observed API&#39;s contract\. A transport connection alone does not establish application authentication or authorization\.
- Acquiring an open connection from a pool can satisfy the connection operation\. This event does not prove that a new physical connection was created\.
- Successful connection establishment does not guarantee subsequent operation success or continued connection availability\.
- This event does not establish that the application has recovered from degraded mode\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not establish connections or change application state\.
